binding_state: DRAFT ONLY, HELD. The direct and lookup source bindings remain unbound until both complete final-output bundles are FINALIZED and COMPLETED and each has one verified first official score. Root must replace every null binding with measured artifact paths and SHA-256 values, register the read release, and review before any semantic result read.

analysis_runner.mode: default saved-score path with explicit finalized-bundle sources; do not use generic-scores-v1

source_analysis_plan.status: ROOT BINDS THE FINAL EXPOSURE AND PROGRAM PLAN AFTER THE PROSPECTIVE RECIPE IS REVIEWED

populations.construction: NEW500 is the existing DEV-1000-NEW500 receipt; OLD500 is the full DEV1000 set difference, and DEV1000 is the pooled full receipt. Do not redraw or promote a secondary population to primary.

one_sided_lower95.tail_definition: lower 5th percentile of the same paired bootstrap draws

metric_labels.row_mean_slu_f1: slu_f1_f1 (mean of per-row official SLU F1)
metric_labels.pooled_slu_micro_f1: slu_f1_micro (pooled official SLU F1 from saved sufficient counts)

source_order: score each complete final-output manifest exactly once through core.scoring_batch with per-sample ingredients
verify each complete-score receipt and saved score bytes
bind the measured source paths and SHA-256 values
run score_compare_cli once with zero new scorer invocations
release semantic comparison only after both sources are sealed and scored
score_source_contract.no_projection: Use the raw slurp-slu-official result; retain the six saved word/character TP, FP and FN fields. Never replace pooled counts with row averages.

diagnostics.sources: Verified first complete score rows and sealed per-row traces; no new quality, reference or current-result read is authorized by this draft.
required_when_available: parse, empty, saturation, retry and fallback outcomes
OBS, ORG, SUPPLY and USE event counts

quality_descriptives.rule: Use only saved official rows and verified sealed traces after the registered read release; do not select outcome-dependent subsets.

estimator_interpretation.sign: lookup minus direct; higher quality is positive
estimator_interpretation.positive: The requested interval for a metric lies wholly above zero; this is exploratory evidence only.
estimator_interpretation.negative: The requested interval lies wholly below zero.
estimator_interpretation.unresolved: Otherwise; report the uncertainty and any intent/entity tradeoff.
estimator_interpretation.next_action: A positive result does not admit the mechanism. Replicate on the same roster or root-cause the result to a named registered component before another mechanism or new roster.

supported_now: DEV1000, NEW500 and derived OLD500 populations
natural-mixture and equal-stratum point reporting with per-stratum rows
pooled slu_f1_micro from saved word/character count fields
complete-score receipt and bundle verification without scorer calls
missing_or_external: score_compare_cli currently emits only its two-sided CI90 result and does not emit the requested one-sided lower-95 percentile; retain that requirement as a held reader-output gap and do not synthesize it from CI90

candidate/rescue/spoil, outside-shortlist intent, invalid/unknown calls, format failures and contact counts are sealed-trace diagnostics outside the shared score projection path; report them only when the retained trace schema supplies them

execution_gate: HELD. This draft contains no source hashes and no read authority. Root must bind both finalized complete-score sources after one-time scoring, register the release, and review the supported one-sided lower-95 output before running the shared comparator.
